services.name: Sunset Flights
services.desc: You are peacefully drifting through the sky while the sun sinks toward the horizon, casting a gorgeous golden light across the landscape below you. You get to witness golden hour, one of the most magnificent parts of the day, from the comfort of a hot air balloon. Rainbow Ryders is your ticket to capturing this experience. We offer sunset flights in Albuquerque from November through January and in Phoenix from November through March. We launch about one hour before sunset, so you can gracefully soar the skies for approximately an hour before landing just in time to witness nightfall.
